data.name: v1.11.0
data.body:
## What's Changed

A continued focus on server and client performance, see the separate section below. We're ensuring Outline maintains it's position as the fastest team knowledge base on the market.

 ### Highlights

  * A drag handle is now available on all root-level blocks in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/12167
  * `Alt`+`Up`/`Down` now moves to the previous or next document in the sidebar in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14034
  * Documents and collections can now record a reason for being archived or deleted in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13784
  * Added Open Knowledge Format (OKF) import in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13580
  * Groups can now optionally have an icon and color in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14011
  * The desktop app now shows a toast with actions when a file download completes in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13769

  ### MCP

  * Skills are now exposed over MCP in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13989
  * The MCP server and OAuth provider now follow the latest MCP spec guidance in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13961

  ### Performance improvements

  * Avoided an N+1 query in share subscription notifications in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13719
  * `documentCollaborativeUpdater` now does its computation outside the transaction in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13720
  * The loading bar now animates with transform in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13755
  * Placeholder candidates are now filtered before conditions are evaluated in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13760
  * Editor decorations are now mapped through inline edits instead of rebuilt in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13759
  * Document sidebar panels now stay mounted with React Activity in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13845
  * Store filter methods are now memoized in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13870
  * Simple read-only comments now render without an editor view in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13871
  * Document row menus and tooltips are now deferred until interaction in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13869
  * Removed redundant queries from document API routes in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13884
  * `documentStructure` is now excluded from the `collections.list` query in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13886
  * Reduced query cost and reparsing in the comments API in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13887
  * Prosemirror parsing is now memoized in `DocumentHelper` in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13892
  * Templates are now loaded on demand in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13895
  * The statement timeout is now sent in the same round trip as the transaction start in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13937
  * The recently viewed documents query is faster in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13970
  * Updating the collection structure no longer loads full subtrees in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13982
  * Sidebar document trees are now virtualized in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13993
  * Reduced editor mount cost in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14032
  * Opening a document from the sidebar now uses less main-thread time in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14033

  ### Other improvements

  * Sidebar section headers now have menus in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13801
  * The child document list now supports multi-select in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13782
  * Users are now notified when added to or removed from a group in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13999
  *  Breadcrumbs are now shown in hovercards in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13876
  * Line-height is now adjusted for Chinese, Japanese and Korean documents by @Tlntin in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13822
  * Date mentions are now formatted per locale in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13969
  * Gmail and Outlook links are now shown after an email sign-in request in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13761
  * The export menu now shows file extensions and the print shortcut in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13778
  * Maximum comment length has been increased to 10k characters in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13814
  * A code block that is most of the document is no longer auto-collapsed in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13815
  * The find panel on mobile now has a close button and a two-line layout in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13818
  * `comments.update` now accepts a `text` param in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13854
  * Added a visible uncollapse sidebar button in the header in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13872
  * Group descriptions are now synced, and groups are re-synced on SSO validation in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13889
  * Root domain app links now redirect to the signed-in workspace in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13923
  * The group members table now shows who added each member in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14000
  * A security notice is now sent to the previous address when an account email changes in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13979
  * Authentication requirements on account settings routes have been tightened in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13980
  * The admin service is now prevented from running in production in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13758
  * Collaboration service now validates awareness identity in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13804
  * Generated team subdomains no longer include the top-level domain in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13816
  * Analytics events are now sent through gtag, and WebMCP tool registration is tracked in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13792

  ### Fixes

  * Service worker is now served with a no-cache header in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13716
  * Native image drag copies selected images by @UmbraCi in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13635
  * Pinned document cards ignore clicks and trackpad taps by @misha-sunborn in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13708
  * Editor node drags show the sidebar document ghost in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13723
  * Checklist with multiple items corrupts neighbouring lists in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13724
  * Crash when image caption blurs during node view teardown in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13731
  * Lightbox flickers at the end of the close animation in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13730
  * Show notice type for list selections in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13721
  * Clarify missing OAuth state errors in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13734
  * Scope authentication matching to the signing-in provider in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13737
  * Temporary multipart upload files are not cleaned up in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13752
  * Incorrect shared document preview links in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13756
  * Source uploads not removed after imports in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13757
  * Guests with edit rights cannot duplicate documents by @breken-ai in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13717
  * GitLab webhook integration updates in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13764
  * Validate share id on public share endpoints in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13766
  * Selection lands after a newly inserted notice instead of inside it in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13768
  * Backspace inside a notice orphans the emptied paragraph in Chrome in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13770
  * Scrollbars visible on the suggestion menu in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13779
  * Table of contents closes immediately on desktop when a header is narrow in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13781
  * Gap between archived/deleted banner and document title too large in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13780
  * Sidebar selection changes when a prompt blocks navigation in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13785
  * Group description not stored on creation in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13791
  * Validate custom theme colors in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13800
  * Enforce `maxLength` for all input paths in `ContentEditable` in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13793
  * Detect new subscriptions with xmax instead of timestamp comparison in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13803
  * Permission select text color too dim in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13805
  * Patch edit mode drops content spliced inside container blocks in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13794
  * Crash when pasting code over a selection near the end of a document in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13807
  * Imported attachment keys end in "null" when no name is set by @mturac in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13750
  * Revisions sometimes attributed to the wrong user in collaborative edits in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13809
  * Tab after a toggle block throws for non-paragraph blocks in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13825
  * Document search trigger fails when tsvector exceeds size limit in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13832
  * Language detection stores nothing for Chinese, Arabic, Persian and others in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13833
  * Update loop in link editor search on focus in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13840
  * Editor steals focus when opening a document that was never edited in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13847
  * Attachments made public when S3 ACLs are disabled in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13867
  * `Cmd`+`Enter` does not submit a new comment in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13865
  * Lazy editor components fail to load after a deploy in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13868
  * Event listener throws when browser dispatches events during render in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13880
  * Line breaks lost in Markdown table cells in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13866
  * Azure profile handling in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13883
  * Group timestamp not updated when membership changes in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13888
  * Role badges wrap in users table in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13893
  * External groups with duplicate names sync inaccurately in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13894
  * Table controls around merged cells in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13897
  * Allow CloudFront origin in CSP `object-src` in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13909
  * Re-authorize collaboration connections on document lifecycle events in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13899
  * Handle sign out events consistently across realtime services in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13936
  * Header buttons not clickable while find panel is open in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13938
  * Header actions overlap the window scrollbar in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13919
  * Improve collaboration connection lifecycle in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13949
  * Consecutive floated images not aligned horizontally in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13900
  * Attachment row not destroyed on failed upload in `files.create` by @okxint in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13914
  * Document and collection mentions on public shares navigate outside the share in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13920
  * Mobile document options drawer visible when printing in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13971
  * Editor crash on keydown events without a key in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13975
  * `findByPk` ignores `rejectOnEmpty` for malformed ids in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13974
  * Lists in table cells lost on Markdown round-trip in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13978
  * Unhandled rejection when Zapier stylesheet fails to load in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13981
  * Guard node view positions after the view is destroyed in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13983
  * "Created by me" tab lists documents the user collaborated on in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13988
  * Custom workspace logo missing from link previews of app pages in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13986
  * Shared documents and unplaced drafts missing from recently viewed in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13987
  * Private-use URI schemes rejected for OAuth redirect URIs by @tahsinrefat22 in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13945
  * Search results not revealed in paginated sidebar collections in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13786
  * Events not emitted when deleting synced groups in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13998
  * Lightbox stays open when editor document is replaced in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14003
  * Viewing a document with URL mentions of documents creates revisions in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14004
  * Table grips hidden behind add row and column controls in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13997
  * Vertical movement of hover card on enter in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14008
  * Select-all checkbox shown on empty tables in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14009
  * Tighten document visibility in realtime and recent views in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14007
  * Spelling, grammar, punctuation, and translation string errors in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14017
  * Negative sign placed incorrectly after currency symbol when sorting tables in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14018
  * Percent signs lost in exported file names in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14019
  * Browser languages without a region not resolved to a supported locale in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14020
  * Author names lost in template variables in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14021
  * Previous team subdomains not all persisted in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14022
  * Share custom slugs not matched exactly when looking up shares in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14025
  * Heading number periods and full text color when not editing in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14026
  * Model fields keyed by minified class name in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14027
  * Tapping a sidebar icon on mobile opens the document instead of expanding it in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14029
  * Table cells with invalid spans in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14028
  * Divider selection color, border color, and drag handle alignment in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14030
  * Emoji menu conflicts with `:::` notice shortcut in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14031
  * Notice toolbar shows on load when document starts with a notice in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14036
  * Backspace does not delete RTL text in some table cells in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14054
  * Consistent client authentication on OAuth token endpoint in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/14055

  ## New Contributors
  * @misha-sunborn made their first contribution in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13708
  * @breken-ai made their first contribution in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13717
  * @Tlntin made their first contribution in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13822
  * @tahsinrefat22 made their first contribution in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13945
  * @hcker2000 made their first contribution in https://github.com/outline/outline/pull/13876

  **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/outline/outline/compare/v1.10.1...v1.11.0
